# axes.library: Vector3D

**Tier:** `foundation`. **File:** [axes.library](../axes.library.md). **Source:** [stdlib/foundation/axes.library.plato, line 161](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/axes.library.plato#L161).

Copied from source, comments included. A comment records intent. The body is the algorithm. Neither is a proof that the result is correct. Names resolve in the whole compilation.

This slice: Vector3D, Direction3D, Opposite.

```plato

    // The unit vector of this oriented axis (the unsigned basis vector times Sign).
    Vector3D(self: SignedAxis3D): Vector3D
        => match (self) {
            PosX => Vector3D.UnitX;
            NegX => Vector3D(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            PosY => Vector3D.UnitY;
            NegY => Vector3D(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
            PosZ => Vector3D.UnitZ;
            NegZ => Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
        };

    // The unit direction of this oriented axis (its vector, already unit length).
    Direction3D(self: SignedAxis3D): Direction3D
        => Direction3D(self.Vector3D);

    // The oppositely oriented axis along the same line: PosX <=> NegX, etc.
    Opposite(self: SignedAxis3D): SignedAxis3D
        => match (self) {
            PosX => SignedAxis3D.NegX;
            NegX => SignedAxis3D.PosX;
            PosY => SignedAxis3D.NegY;
            NegY => SignedAxis3D.PosY;
            PosZ => SignedAxis3D.NegZ;
            NegZ => SignedAxis3D.PosZ;
        };
}
```
